subject: Northseed: staged project rollout, new API keys & staggered onboarding
content:
From: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@northseed.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@northseed.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged rollout: 3 new projects + API key plan

Hi Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move forward with adding three more internal projects onto the account (Clinical Bots, Intake Forms, and Reporting ETL). Before we schedule the kickoff, can you confirm:

- How you recommend assigning API keys (one per project vs per environment).
- Any quota/limits we should expect per key for initial burst phases.
- Expected timelines to provision keys, and if we can stage activation by team.

I attached a draft scope and a simple key matrix. High level ask is: staggered provisioning over three sprints, initial traffic capped to avoid rate-limit surprises.

Also, Priya and I want to discuss whether we can get a short-term uplift in quota for the first 30 days (pilot) — not a contract change yet, just a temporary capacity increase.

Can you and Monica confirm what you need from procurement/security to move keys and a short pilot uplift?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Murphy
Head of Product, Northseed Health
[Attachment: Northseed_Scope_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: northseed_key_matrix.csv (csv)]

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@northseed.io>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@northseed.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged rollout: 3 new projects + API key plan

Alex, Priya —

Appreciate the scope doc. Quick answers below and then I’ll loop in Karthik for the provisioning runbook.

- API key strategy: recommended: one key per project + one separate key per non-prod environment (dev/stage). That gives visibility and per-project throttling. If you prefer less granularity we can do a single project key and use route tags, but billing/usage breakdown becomes harder.

- Quota/limits: For initial pilot we can provision keys with a soft throughput cap of 60 requests/sec across the account and token-rate caps per key. We can temporarily raise that cap for the 30-day pilot subject to a usage review and rate-safety rules.

- Timeline: keys can be generated within 24 business hours after we receive the signed technical onboarding form and the list of project owners for each key. Staggered activation: we can do Clinical Bots (week 1), Intake Forms (week 2), Reporting ETL (week 3).

Action items for Northseed:
1) Confirm project owners + environment list in the CSV (Priya)
2) Sign the onboarding form (attached via DocuSign link or reply with approval)

I’m looping in Karthik (ops) and Monica (CS) to confirm the provisioning checklist and the short-term uplift behavior.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Director, Account Expansion | Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@northseed.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@northseed.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged rollout: 3 new projects + API key plan

Folks —

I took a quick pass at the key matrix. A couple of operational notes:

- We will create keys in the customer namespace and assign metadata tags: project, environment, owner, SLA-tier. That makes it easy to apply route policies and throttles.
- For the short-term uplift: we can provision a temporary policy that increases throughput by 2x for 30 days. That policy auto-reverts unless an extension is requested. We will need an internal approval ticket for capacity planning (INF-2248) — please expect a 48-hour review for risk checks.
- Security checklist: Northseed needs to provide the list of intended IP allowlist entries or VPC peering details if you want region-limited access. Also required: the signed technical onboarding form and an emergency contact for rate-surge events.

I’ll prepare a provisioning runbook and send it by EOD tomorrow. Monica — can you confirm CS will lead the sprint kickoff and the canary monitoring during week 1?

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@northseed.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged rollout: 3 new projects + API key plan

Thanks — quick clarifications from our side:

- Project owners: confirmed in the CSV (I updated owner emails for Clinical Bots and Reporting ETL).
- IP allowlist: Intake Forms will be from our managed cloud (10.4.0.0/22) — I included the CIDR in the sheet.
- Pilot uplift: we’re OK with the 2x temporary policy as long as there’s an auto-revert and a notification 5 days before it expires.

Also: can the Reporting ETL key be provisioned in a read-only mode to start (only embeddings + short generation calls)? We want to limit write-heavy calls until we validate cost.

Priya
Head of Platform Engineering, Northseed Health

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Murphy <alex.murphy@northseed.io>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@northseed.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged rollout: 3 new projects + API key plan

Alex, Priya —

All set on our side. Summary / next steps:

1) Documents received: scope PDF + CSV (locked to the email thread) — thanks.
2) Aditya will issue the DocuSign onboarding form this afternoon. Please sign to trigger key provisioning.
3) Karthik will post the provisioning runbook to the Jira ticket (INF-2248) by tomorrow EOD.
4) Temporary uplift: approved for 30 days at 2x with an automatic revert and a 5-day expiry notification. We will also send a usage snapshot at days 7, 14 and 28.
5) Reporting ETL key: can be created with restricted policy (embeddings + capped generations). We’ll expose a metrics dashboard for cost-tracking.

Kickoff: proposed Monday next week — CS-led canary during week 1. Lauren will join the kickoff to align enablement docs and playbooks.

Attachments: provisioning-checklist.txt (stub)

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: provisioning-checklist.txt (text)]
